facts.text: I asked to take the chat so far into consideration for screening tools, Inditech products, and mental health.
I asked for 25 new ideas for posts based on the additional material I provided.
I provided material stating that diagnosis rates of special conditions in general practice clinics and general pediatrics clinics in India are quite low.
I provided material stating that patients are often referred to specialists quite late when the condition has already worsened.
I provided material stating that screening tools should surface red flags for special conditions and alert the doctor.
I provided material stating that doctor-to-doctor specialist advice should accompany screening tools for local investigations and timely referrals.
I provided material stating that straightforward cases can be treated locally under expert advice with referrals limited to complicated cases.
I provided material stating that early diagnosis and local treatment improve patient outcomes.
I provided material stating that primary care clinics benefit through patient retention, local investigations, and local treatment that add income.
I provided material stating that specialists benefit through consultation fees from doctor-to-doctor consultations and a referral pipeline for complicated cases.
I provided material stating that Inditech's screening tools and specialist advice systems cover many special conditions and almost all specialties in pediatrics.
I provided material stating that over 60 pharma brands have participated in Inditech programs so far.
I asked to create a post for the Inditech page on the second idea about the benefits of providing primary care clinics with advanced screening tools.
I asked the post to be not over 300 words.
I provided a description of problems in General Practice clinics in India including patients not coming for timely intervention.
I provided a description stating that general practitioners are not able to diagnose or treat special conditions.
I provided a description stating that general practice clinics don't offer preventive, monitoring, or management services for non-communicable diseases and chronic conditions.
I provided a description stating that Inditech brings early detection and specialized capabilities to primary care clinics.
I provided a description stating that Inditech brings education to doctors from leading experts and academies.
I provided a description stating that Inditech brings in-clinic education, screening tools, red-flag alerts, and doctor-to-doctor specialist advice.
I provided a description stating that Inditech brings specialized services to the clinic to prevent and manage chronic conditions.
I provided a description stating that Inditech delivers professional education for doctors from India's leading experts and is endorsed by medical academies.
I provided a description stating that Inditech delivers education in certificate online education modules, online/offline/hybrid classroom education, workshops, and case study clinics.
I provided a description stating that Inditech enables practical use of academy-endorsed education by extending it into general practice clinics for early detection and intervention.
I provided a description stating that Inditech provides short format education on red flags suitable for in-clinic distribution and consumption.
I provided a description stating that Inditech provides doctor-personalized multilingual patient screening tools that report red flags to doctors.
I provided a description stating that Inditech provides screening tools for use by the doctor to identify red flags.

I provided a description stating that when a red flag is noticed, the general practice clinic will have doctor-to-doctor specialist advice to investigate and treat locally under expert advice or make a timely referral.

I provided a description stating that Inditech connects specialized digital therapeutics services to the general practice clinic to prevent, monitor, and manage chronic conditions and non-communicable diseases.
I provided a description stating that Inditech leverages connections with experts and medical academies to create these solutions.

I provided a description stating that Inditech works with pharma brands to distribute these services to general practice clinics and uses pharma companies to recruit specialists for the doctor-to-doctor specialist advice system.
I provided a description stating that pharma brands in India spend most of their marketing and sales budgets on enhancing relationships with doctors and specialists.
I provided a description stating that pharma brands' value-based activities are mostly limited to hosting or sponsoring professional education events.
I provided a description stating that Inditech's solutions are a win-win opportunity for brands to partner with Inditech for therapy areas.
I provided a description stating that brands can become distribution or promotion partners for Inditech's services to doctors/clinics they target.
I provided a description stating that brands can become recruitment partners for specialists in specific therapy areas for a region.
I provided a description stating that Inditech benefits by revenue where the pharma brand partner pays Inditech a fee for each doctor served under the partnership.
I asked to write a post expanding only on the theme of how Inditech transforms Continuing Medical Education into practical education useful in clinics and at the point of care.
I asked the post to be less than 200 words.
